povRegister.registerSummary: Clipped, dry Ranger-General. She thinks in ground, tracks, lines and cover, swears by the sun or 'damn', and argues with herself in short self-questions she answers and overrules ('A doe is a doe. Find out.'). She is unfair to magisters and to the Convocation, names feelings only as irritation or body facts, and does not reach for aphorism, paradox or thematic captions.

findings.issue: Agreement echo. It hands back Cyndia's 'A cow' with 'then' added: no new fact, joke or turn (the same shape as the guide's 'Most likely,' she agreed).

findings.issue: Sign-off tag 'That's all.' The first clause ('nobody up here but us') already gives the reassurance. Neral uses the same sign-off again at L383, where it does carry content ('I'm going to sit on the bottom of it. That's all.'), so this weaker one goes.

findings.textureZone: texture_desert 'That's all.' A boot heel would split that hatch... (L367-L371)

findings.text: The coats were on the pegs and the boots were gone. The bread was on the boards and the people were gone.

findings.suggestedFix: The coats were on the pegs and the bread on the boards, and the boots and the people were gone.

findings.textureZone: texture_desert 'He had not come back for it...' (L51-L69)

findings.issue: Anaphoric run in speech ('Louder than' x2). 'Louder than anything' adds weight and no fact.

findings.suggestedFix: She found nothing on the bank, at the sides or ahead of the first of them.

audits.f1Note: No sentence-level F1 kill. The telegram runs and texture deserts the rhythm scorer flags are mostly in dialogue exchanges (the cellar interview, the cut). The narration varies its paragraph shapes, and the comma-plus-ing tails are isolated, never three in one paragraph. The structural rhythm concerns are recorded in summary.rhythmMetrics.
audits.f5Note: No F5 kill. Scene 1 keeps the mage-Sylvanas friction ('Damn her, then.') and ends with no direction. Scene 2 has Sylvanas frighten the girl and refuse to send Neral until first light. Scene 3 ends with the duty-versus-trail argument open and a farm door shut on them.
audits.f13Note: No F13 kill. 'That was true, and very convenient, which she would have pointed out to anyone else.' (L717) keeps its caption frame because the voice sheet uses that exact self-mocking shape.
audits.severityMarkers: F3 SEVERE at L551 (stacked hedges). F14 MODERATE x3 (three fenced manner adverbs in scene 2: a habit).

findings.text: A cat, and no dogs. A coat on every peg and nobody to put one on.
findings.issue: Thesis-fragment pair pinned over the scene. It re-captions L67 (coats on pegs, no dogs) as an epigraph. The previous sentence about the cat already does the counting the beat wants.
findings.povMismatch: An epigraph-shaped caption restating evidence she logged one paragraph earlier; a summary rather than the next thing she notices.
findings.fixNote: Delete both fragments; the paragraph ends on the cat sentence.

findings.text: You kept it the way you kept a hoofprint you couldn't place, at the back of your head with the others, and walked on.
findings.issue: Generic-you maxim closing the grain-seller plant, and the third generic-you construction in the chapter (L69, L419, L471). L69 and L419 are her working idiom and drive decisions; this one is an aphorism. The hoofprint image is hers and can stay inside her POV.
findings.suggestedFix: She put it at the back of her head with the hoofprints she couldn't place, and let it lie.
findings.povMismatch: Rounded maxim addressed to an imagined reader, not her own decision in the moment.

findings.text: They had just gone, all together, uphill, the way water goes downhill.
findings.issue: Too polished for the POV. The uphill/downhill paradox is a writerly turn on the sentence itself. Sylvanas, mid-read, would mutter 'They had just gone,' not frame a chiasmus.
findings.suggestedFix: They had just gone, all together, uphill.
findings.povMismatch: Paradox flourish she would not say under her breath while hunting a stray print.

audits.keepRateNote: The keep rate is above the guide's 25% heuristic. Three keeps are mandatory tool-signal reviews (hedge_perhaps x2, hedge_might_have_been) whose hedges are genuine field estimates. The rest are anchored shorthand whose concrete payload sits in the same or the adjacent line.

audits.cleanReason: No exchange claims plainer speech and fails. Eight translation-shaped exchanges were checked. 'How much is here, you've told me. Which way it went, you can't.' (L227) is a usable state. 'You did the rooms. Now do the places a person would fold up small' (L295) is anchored by the hiding-place list at L291. 'Can you tell her which marks are which?' (L617) is answered mark by mark. 'Ask her how she knows which way' (L497) gets 'The little window'. 'Which is the north road?' (L533) gets a pointed arm and 'Up the cow way'. 'What's it like down there? Who's still trading?' (L765) gets the ford market, chimney smoke and the barley price. The dispatch (L707) names the ring stretch and the high ground. The mage's 'not a knot... a stain in a cloth' (L833) gives a usable knot-versus-spread distinction; its closer is killed separately under phantom P3. Each reply hands the listener a target, sign or order.

summary.fixConvention: suggestedFix replaces the exact cited text. An empty string means delete the cited text; see fixNote for paragraph handling.
summary.fixStrategy: default (iterationKillsB history [56]; this sweep is lower, so the trajectory is decreasing)
summary.verdictReason: 42 kills (38 MILD, 4 MODERATE/SEVERE). There is one SEVERE F3 stacked hedge (L551) and three MODERATE F14 fenced manner adverbs in scene 2, so the pass fails on severity as well as on the MILD count. The dominant residue is gpt-5 F12 non-action beats and F9 repeated vocatives, plus a few F4/F7 closure lines. Narrator seep is light (3) and phantom concreteness light (4). Fake simplification is clean. Structural rhythm concerns: sentence_length_cv, short_sentence_pct, long_sentence_pct, opener_entropy, one_sentence_paragraph_pct, mattr. Structural texture deficit: texture below_target (75.2), participial 4.8% vs 12% target, with 28 telegram runs and 29 texture deserts.
